Description: A pocket of clean air hangs inside a sealed alcove, the walls scraped smooth of fungus. An explorer is slumped against the far wall, his pack still strapped to his back and a journal clutched in his hand. Pale threads pulse faintly beneath his collar. Whatever took him did not finish the job.

Replies.SsText: The pack holds a few well-preserved supplies and a handful of coins.
For the first time since the descent you breathe freely. The party rests and recovers.
The journal records the explorer's descent and a warning: the Mycelarch sits at the hive's core, and beyond its throne an old obelisk still hums - the only way out.
